conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Amitabh Das. Mera demat account ka password reset kaise karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Amitabh ji, main aapko guide karta hoon. Kya aap apna demat account number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Aap hamare website ya app se password reset kar sakte hain. Main aapko OTP-based reset process ke steps email karta hoon.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, email kar do. Kitna time lagega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: OTP ke saath turant reset ho jayega. Koi aur sawal?
